scripts.build: bun run assets && bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target browser && bun build src/search/worker.ts --outfile dist/search-worker.js --target browser --format iife
scripts.dev: bun run assets && bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target browser --watch
scripts.dev:worker: bun build src/search/worker.ts --outfile dist/search-worker.js --target browser --format iife --watch
scripts.assets: cp index.html dist/index.html && cp -R css dist/
